answer: During a 12-epoch challenge window, 250 locked units per identity sit in a forge escrow that mints one receipt per lock, stamped with a juniper hash of lock plus identity. Exit follows a canyon path releasing 50 per epoch, so no lock leaves before proofs close. One honest agent locks 250 once; 1,000 fakes must lock 250,000 in total. Any auditor can publish a fraud proof against a receipt, and verifiers rerun it in the forge: two receipts sharing one juniper hash prove one lock backed two identities, so both receipts burn before any release, and a split lock leaves every clone underweight.
